Class ColorManipulation

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.color.ColorManipulation
public final class ColorManipulation extends Object
Color manipulation operations and color space conversions.

Provides both low-level color space conversions (RGB/HSL/HSV) and high-level semantic operations (lighten, darken, blend, contrast).

      public static float[] rgbToHsl(int r, int g, int b)
      Converts RGB to HSL color space.
      Parameters:
      r - red component (0-255)
      g - green component (0-255)
      b - blue component (0-255)
      Returns:

    • getContrastText

      public static Color getContrastText(Color background)
      Returns a contrasting text color (black or white) based on background luminance. Uses WCAG relative luminance calculation.
      Parameters:
      background - the background color
      Returns:
      white for dark backgrounds, black for light backgrounds
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if background is null

    • withAlpha

      public static Color withAlpha(Color color, float alpha)
      Applies alpha/transparency to a color. Note: Current Color interface doesn't support alpha, so this is a no-op. Reserved for future RGBA support.
      Parameters:
      color - the base color
      alpha - alpha value (0.0 to 1.0)
      Returns:
      the color (unchanged until RGBA support added)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if color is null
